title: Beneficiary Designations on Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance Policies
content:
**Ashgrove CareAssure beneficiary designations (Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance)**

The owner names primary and contingent beneficiaries for the death benefit. A beneficiary designation is recorded only while the policy status is Applied, In Force, Grace Period, Paid Up, Claim Active, Benefits Exhausted or Shortened Benefit. A changed designation is recorded only from a beneficiary change request signed by the owner, and, where the current designation names an irrevocable beneficiary, also signed in consent by that beneficiary. The new designation replaces the earlier one entirely, effective on the owner's signature date if signed while the insured was living. Shares are whole percents of at least the tier's smallest beneficiary share, totalling 100 in each class, with no more than the tier's maximum number of primaries. Long-term care benefits are always paid to the owner or the care provider the owner assigns, never to beneficiaries.

The original designation made at issue takes effect on the issue date. The policy status, the change request and whether the current designation is irrevocable are read from the company's record.

**Status in which a designation is recorded**

| Recorded | Not recorded |
|---|---|
| Applied, In Force, Grace Period, Paid Up, Claim Active, Benefits Exhausted, Shortened Benefit | Lapsed, Surrendered, Death Claim Pending, Claim Paid, Claim Denied, Cancelled under the free look, Declined |

**Signatures on a change**

| Current designation names an irrevocable beneficiary | Signed by the owner | Consent signed by the irrevocable beneficiary | Change recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| No | Yes | — | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | No | No |
| — | No | — | No |

**Share checks (hypothetical designations; CareAssure limits of 1 percent smallest share and 10 primaries)**

| Primary class | Contingent class | Valid |
|---|---|---|
| 60 and 40 | 100 | Yes |
| 50, 25 and 25 | 50 and 50 | Yes |
| 70 and 20 | 100 | No — the primary class totals 90 |
| 99.5 and 0.5 | 100 | No — shares must be whole percents of at least 1 |

**Replacement.** A new designation replaces the earlier one entirely: a contingent named only in the earlier designation is no longer a beneficiary once the new one takes effect. A change signed by the owner on a hypothetical 4 May while the insured was living takes effect on 4 May.
